messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "symptoms go away after stopping medication"
set: ["symptoms go away after stopping medication", "stopping abruptly can cause serious withdrawal symptoms", "stopping may not be safe", "stopping treatment is not automatically safer", "stopping abruptly can cause uncontrolled pain", "stopping suddenly can trigger thyroid crisis", "symptoms usually not serious", "withdrawal symptoms if stopped suddenly", "stopping suddenly may cause chest pain or heart attack", "stopping may increase risk of heart attack or stroke", "symptoms especially reported when stopped abruptly", "opioids can cause sudden withdrawal symptoms", "stopping suddenly can increase risk of blood clot or stroke", "stopping beta blocker abruptly can bring on worse chest pain", "stopping beta blocker abruptly can bring on a heart attack", "withdrawal symptoms if combined with certain medicines"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
